goad.source: notes/src/environments.md #13 (prior dimension-level analysis); element-level scores from the 2026-08-11 review, cross-checked with orange-cyberdefense.github.io/GOAD, github.com/Orange-Cyberdefense/GOAD, and community write-ups (Mayfly GOADv2 series) for ADCS/ESC coverage, the account-lockout policy, the eddard.stark/robb.stark scheduled bot scripts, and the castelblack IIS upload vulnerability; reviewed with an independent codex pass
